title: Ao no Exorcist: Ura Eku
justification: AniList 10647 (SPECIAL, 10 episode(s) from 2011-06-22) is AniDB 8148's special(s) S2-S11, aired 2011-06-22 to 2012-03-21. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8148. The parent's row start 2 end 11 offset -1 puts S2-S11 on TVDB 0x1-0x10, 'Ura Ex 1-10', same dates.
